Commentary.Commentary: A dismal batting performance by Ireland! They started sensibly after electing to bat but failed to build enough partnerships. The wickets continued to tumble at regular intervals as the English bowlers applied pressure. Adil Rashid was the chief tormentor, claiming his maiden fifer in ODIs and along with Joe Root just dismantled the Irish middle order. It's a below par total and England will look to chase it down quickly. Stay tuned, they will be out soon...

OUT! Maiden 5-wicket haul for Adil Rashid in ODIs! Fuller on middle and leg, Tim Murtagh has had enough and looks to go big over the long on region but finds the fielder in the deep. Hales takes the catch and that is it for the visitors. Ireland bowled out for 126!
FOUR! Smashed away! Full toss on the stumps, Murtagh comes down the wicket and thumps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fired on the pads, Chase clips it through square leg for a single to get off the mark.
Another appeal! Lands this googly on the stumps, Chase looks to defend but is hit on his pads. The player appeal but nothing from the umpire.

OUT! Another big wicket! Rashid bowls it around middle and off, Niall kneels down to sweep but misses and is struck in front of the stumps. The players appeal and the umpire again rules it in favour of the bowler. O'Brien is livid with himself but there is nothing much he can do now and has to walk back to the hut. England just a wicket away. PETER CHASE walks out to bat.
Bowls it on leg, Niall sweeps it to short fine leg from his crease.
Beaten! On a length outside off, Murtagh makes room and flings his bat at it but makes no contact.
FOUR! STREAKY RUNS! This time Murtagh gets some bat as he goes for the pull but it's a top edge that flies over Billings towards the fence. Cannot set a field for shots like these.
Short ball around off, Murtagh is beaten as he tries to go for the pull.
Length ball around off, pushed with soft hands towards the off side. Single taken.
Good length wider outside off, makes room and pats it towards extra cover for a single.
On a length outside off, punched off the back foot towards mid off.
Another googly and O'Brien gets an edge on the push. The ball bobbles towards point.
Fired in around middle, dug out to long on for a single.
Fuller on middle, leans across to that one and flicks it towards long on for a run.
Beaten! The googly and O'Brien doesn't pick it and is beaten on the push.
The googly outside off, pushed towards cover with the turn for a single.
Fuller around off, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and outside off, patted gently back to the bowler.
Drifting in around off, gets back and pushes it towards the bowler.
Flatter outside off, stays back and blocks it well.
Loopy and wider outside off, crisply driven to sweeper cover for a single,.
Drifting away well outside off, no shot offered by Niall.
Floated wider outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Leans forward and hits it hard towards mid-wicket.
A googly around off, Tim picks it and blocks.
Bunts it down to long on for a run.
Keeps it short around off, Niall hangs back in defense.
Flighted on off, defended back.
Shortish on off, played down to mid-wicket.
Strides forward and defends it back to end an excellent over.
Quicker again on off, Murtagh keeps it out off the inner edge to square leg.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. Root sends across a quicker one in the line the stumps, Dockrell is late in bringing his bat down and takes a beating on his pads. They appeal and the finger goes up. Tim Murtagh is in next to bat for Ireland.
Quicker on off, tapped to point.
Leans forward to a full ball in defense.
Flatter and fuller ball on off, Niall inside edges his attempted short to fine leg for a single.

OUT! Rashid strikes twice in the over! Bowls another googly, Thompson does not pick it and plays down the wrong line. The ball sneaks through to hit the timber and that is it for Stuart. Ireland are now seven down for just 108.  GEORGE DOCKRELL is the new man in.
FOUR! Vital hit! Rashid bowls this outside off, Stuart Thompson gets under it and drives it on the up wide of covers for a boundary.
Very full from Rashid, nudged towards the leg side off the inside edge by Thompson.

OUT! That is a big wicket for England! Googly from Rashid, Kevin fails to get his bat down in time to counter it. The ball raps him on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire rules it in favour of the bowler. Ireland sink further. STUART THOMPSON WALKS OUT TO BAT.
Nudges this one to square leg for a single.
Flights this one, Niall comes down the wicket and defends it back down the wicket.
Tossed up delivery, driven through mid on for a single.
Flatter ball on the stumps, Kevin looks to clip but is hit on his pads. A leg bye results as the ball rolls off the pads to the leg side.
Gets it square of the wicket for a single.
Round the wicket and on the stumps, Niall defends it.
Gets across and pushes this one through mid off for a single.
Pushes this one to mid off from his crease.
Niall gets in line and defends this one.
Gets a leading edge to this one but thankfully no harm done.
Pushes  this one to point for a single.
Niall looks to defend but gets an edge to third man for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, turned towards the leg side by Niall.
Loops it on middle and leg, turns away, the batsman misses his clip. A wide is signaled.
Bowls it around off, Niall stays back and defends it at the last moment.
Pushes this one to point for a single.
Drives it through mid on but not for any run.
Niall comes forward to defend but fails to put bat to ball.
Flighted and outside off, tapped down to point.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. They pick up a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, going straight on, Kevin plays for the spin and is beaten.
Tossed up ball outside off, Kevin tries to push through the line but it catches the inside edge and rolls through square leg for a single.
Kevin O'Brien walks out to bat.

OUT! The decision stays as it is! A tossed up ball landing around off and spinning back in, a googly, Wilson tries to sweep across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up after a while. Gary Wilson opts for the DRS but the replays show that it hit him in line and was crashing onto the stumps. Only an inside edge would have saved him but there wasn't any. Ireland continue to struggle!
Drama! Wilson is given out lbw but he is sure about gloving it and has gone for a review.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy and on off, Wilson paddles it around the corner but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Tossed up and outside off, O'Brien pushes it softly to covers and pinches a single.
Flighted full ball on leg, defended back to the left side of the bowler.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Tossed up ball on off, pushed to covers where the fielder quickly got to the ball and stopped them from crossing.
Loopy and outside off, an easy leave for Niall.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Gary Wilson walks out to bat.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Root serves a slow loopy full ball around off, Porterfield tries to loft it over mid off but fails to get the desired connection. He ends up handing a simple catch to Plunkett inside the ring who accepts it gleefully. Ireland's innings continues to be marred by the fall of wickets at regular intervals.
Flighted on off, pushed back firmly to the bowler.
Joe Root comes on for a bowl.
Shorter and in the line of the stumps, Porterfield moves back, exposes all his stumps and slaps it through covers for a run.
Flatter and around off, O'Brien gets back and helps it through square leg for one.
Leans forward to a full ball and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and outside off, smashed to extra cover where the fielder made a diving stop. He had an immediate shy at the bowler's end but missed as Niall dived in.
Full toss around middle, William swings his bat, doesn't middle it properly but still gets it over mid-wicket. A couple taken.
Floated ball on off, defended back to the bowler.
Play and a miss! Angles in a length ball outside off, from around the wicket, straightening a touch, O'Brien gets forward to push at it but is beaten.
Another watchful leave outside the off stump by Niall.
Good length delivery outside off, O'Brien allows it through.
A touch short and outside off, Williams moves across the stumps and turns it behind square leg for a single.
Full and wide outside off, Porterfield walks across the stumps and pushes it straight to extra cover.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it down watchfully.
Beaten! Beautifully bowled googly. Landing around off and curling away, Niall gets back to defend, thinking it will spin back in but the ball curls away to beat the outside edge.
More like it. Plays it with the spin and finds the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Another attempted reverse sweep by the Irish skipper but he fails to middle it. Don't think there is any need to be fancy at the moment.
Nearly a return catch! Tossed up ball around off, William tries hitting across the line but ends up pushing it straight back. It's uppish but goes on one bounce to the bowler.
Probably a googly, landing outside off and spinning away, Porterfield tries to play the reverse sweep but fails to connect.
Flatter delivery to start with, a touch short and outside off, O'Brien pushes it gently in the gap at covers for a quick single.
Adil Rashid brought on for a bowl. A slip in place.
Good length outside off, nudged towards the leg side by Porterfield.
Fuller outside off, O'Brien gets an edge as he looks to defend it. The ball rolls towards third man for a single.
Niall O'Brien walks out to bat.
Drinks.

OUT! The ploy works! Ball slants in a good length delivery outside off, Balbirnie throws his bat at it. This time he does not get lucky and gets an edge. Billings goes to his right and takes a superb catch. One more start wasted and Andy walks back to the hut. England once again have broken a stand before it could get too threatening for them.
Good length outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Fuller in length, around off, dug out back towards the bowler. Ball leaps up and collects the ball.
Good length outside off, bounces a touch more as Balbirnie is beaten on his cut short. That wasn't that wide to be cut away.
Bowls it on a length on the stumps, Porterfield looks to clip it through but is hit on his pads. He has not got going today.
Good length outside off, Porterfield punches it towards covers.
Fuller in length, hit wide of mid on again for a single.
Fuller around off, clipped towards mid on by Balbirnie.
Good length outside off, pushed to point by Balbirnie.
Slants it full and on middle, Balbirnie clips it wide of mid on for a brace.
Good length around off, worked to mid-wicket for a single. Good over for Ireland.
Good length outside off, Balbirnie gets in line and defends it.
Fuller outside off, another leave by Andy.
Pitched up outside off, left alone by the batsman.

FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Slants it on middle and leg, Balbirnie gets in line and clips it down to fine leg. Rashid comes across from fine leg but cannot stop the ball going through. Andy has batted well so far.
FOUR! Hit away! Good length outside off, Balbirnie stays tall and cuts it hard behind point for a boundary. Superb shot, that!
Fuller outside off, driven to mid off by Porterfield.
Fuller outside off, Porterfield goes back at first, then comes half forward to mistime it to covers.
Good length outside off, Porterfield dabs it to point and looks for a single but it is never on.
Fuller outside off, hit towards mid off by the batsman. He is taking his time here.
Fuller outside off, Porterfield comes forward and defends it.
Slants it on the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Porterfield cuts it hard but finds the fielder in the deep for a single.
Angles it on a length, clipped to wide mid on for a single.
Edged! Slants in a good length delivery outside off, Balbirnie defends it off the outer half towards point.
Good length outside off, Porterfield pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, William drives it to mid off coming a touch forward.
A tight forward defense from Andy to end the over. 10 runs off it.

FOUR! Edged again! Outside off on a good length, Balbirnie pokes at it and gets an outside edge. Root is standing wide at first slip and the ball goes between him and the keeper for a boundary. Plunkett is not amused one bit.
FOUR! Too full outside off, Balbirnie gets his bat down in time and squeezes it to the left of the wide first slip fielder for a boundary. It came off the edge!
Angles it outside off on a length, keeps a touch low, Andy keeps it out watchfully.
Slants across a length ball outside off, Porterfield slaps it through covers for a single.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, pushed to covers for a single by Balbirnie.
Liam Plunkett called on for a bowl. Should be interesting to see what lengths he bowls here. He is playing his 50th ODI game today!
Fuller outside off, hit towards covers by Porterfield.
Full outside off, William stays back and defends it.
BEATEN! Slants it on a good length just around off, comes in, in the air, pitches and just holds its line. Porterfield looks to play but is beaten all ends up.
Angles in a good length delivery on off, Porterfield gets in line and defends it.
Plunkett warming up for a bowl. Ball to bowl round the wicket to the Irish skipper.
Full again outside off, Balbirnie comes forward and guides it to third man for a single.
Fuller length outside off, Balbirnie comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Jake Ball comes on for a bowl.
Fuller length just around off, Balbirnie drives it nicely to mid on for a single.
Back of a length on the stumps, Andy looks to pull it through square leg but is hit on his body.
On a length just around off, played back to the bowler. Willey gets a hand to it and parries it to the fielder coming in from mid off.
Full outside off, Balbirnie comes forward to defend this but is again beaten by the angle.
Good length on off, Andy defends it from his crease.
Fuller around off, clipped through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. There was a slight confusion but no harm done.
The umpire signals the start of the second Powerplay. Four fielders are now allowed outside the circle for the next thirty overs.
Fuller outside off, defended towards mid off by the batsman. A very good Powerplay for England after the start for Ireland.
Lands it outside off, guided towards point by Porterfield.
Good length outside off, Porterfield defends it back down the wicket.
Good length on off, turned towards the leg side where Hales does the fielding.
Shorter length just around off, Balbirnie is late into his pull shot. He gets it off the top edge which does not carry to Rashid coming in from deep fine leg. They pick up a single.
Good length around off, worked towards square leg by Balbirnie.
Full outside off, driven to wide mid off for a single to get off the mark. Another top over!
Lands it outside off on a fuller length, defended watchfully towards covers by the batsman.
Brings this one a touch in from around off, Andy covers the line and defends it towards the on side.
Outside off on a length, Balbirnie comes forward and looks to defend but is beaten all ends up. He was beaten on the angle there as there is not much swing on offer.
Fuller outside off, Balbirnie comes forward and defends it.
Slower in pace, fuller length, William is lured into the drive and gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a single.
Edged! Full outside off, Porterfield looks to defend but gets an outside edge to third man for a single. Good over that for Wood. He's getting into his groove here.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it on off, Porterfield looks to clip it through mid on but the bowler goes to his left and stops the ball.
Wood loses his run-up once again. There is a strong breeze blowing across him.
Bowls it wide outside off on a good length, Porterfield lets it go again.
Hurls it outside off on a good length, another leave by the batsman.
Slants it on a length just around off, pushed towards mid off by the batsman.
Good length outside off, Porterfield defends it.
Andy Balbirnie is the new man in.

OUT! Willey proves us wrong! Full and straight on the stumps, Joyce looks to clip it through but is rapped on the pads. The players appeal for an lbw and the umpire rules it out. Joyce has to depart after a start as well. England coming back well in the game. That was asking to be hit but Ed just missed a straight ball. Replays showed three reds so that was out all the while.
That came in! Hurls it outside off on a length, swings in a long way, Joyce lets it go but the ball was perilously close to the off stump.
FOUR! Hit away! Lands it outside off on a good length, Joyce camps back and cuts it past point for a boundary. Willey has not found his length today.
Angles it on the stumps, worked nicely off the pads towards mid on for a quick single.
Outside off on a length this time, another leave by William.
Full outside off, left alone by Porterfield.
Shorter in length on middle and leg, Joyce ducks under it.
Angled on the stumps, worked towards mid on for a single by Porterfield to get off the mark.
William Porterfield is the new man in.

OUT! Timber! Wood bowls it on a length and straight on the stumps, Paul Stirling looks for an on the up drive down the ground but misses. The ball goes through to crash into the stumps and that ends Stirling's cameo. The batsman was beaten by the extra pace on that one. Wood strikes first up!
Spears it on a length on the stumps again, Paul looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length on middle and leg, defended back down the wicket.

FIVE OVERTHROWS! Good length ball around off, tapped towards covers for a single. The fielder had a shy at the bowler's end but missed his throw and the ball ran into the fence for a boundary. Jonny Bairstow was the fielder there. Joyce is not going to mind this at all.
Slants it on a good length on middle, Stirling looks to pull it over the on side but gets hit on his back leg. Stifled appeal but turned down.
Edged! Length ball just around off, Stirling is squared up a touch but does well to defend it off the outer half towards the off side.
FOUR! Three in a row! Full outside off, Paul Stirling just comes forward and caresses it through covers for a majestic boundary. That came off the middle of the bat.

FOUR! Smartly done! Outside off on a good length, Stirling spots the width and just opens the face of the bat to get it wide of the first slip fielder for a boundary. This is a good start for Ireland!
FOUR! Boom, get out of the way! Good length outside off, Stirling just stands tall and bashes it past the non-striker for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Paul creams it to point from his crease. The ball is not swinging that much.
On a good length outside off, left alone by Ed.
Shorter outside off, Joyce places it behind point and takes a couple of runs as Rashid at third man had a lot of ground to cover.
A tad shorter on off, Joyce picks the length and lets it go through. That bounced over the stumps nicely.
Back of a length around off, Joyce looks to pull but mistimes it towards short mid-wicket. Wood is getting the ball to zip off the surface.
Good length again outside off, Paul lets it go through.
Ohh! Good length just outside off, Joyce looks to defend it from his crease but is beaten all ends up.
FOUR! Edged! Full outside off, Stirling throws his bat at it. He gets an outside edge which flies past the first slip fielder for a boundary. Willey is not happy.
Square leg goes back.
Length outside off, guided to point by Stirling.
Full outside off, Paul comes forward and defends it to covers.
Just wide! Angles it on a fuller length, Stirling looks to go over the on side but the bat turns in his hands. He gets it just past a leaping short mid-wicket. The mid on fielder mops it up.
Stirling gets across and defends this one back to the bowler.

FOUR! Thumped! Slants it outside off on a length, Stirling stays tall and just crashes it through covers for a boundary. Willey was looking to bring back into the batsman but bowled it far too wide. Paul gets off the mark at last!
FOUR! Pristine timing! Too full outside off, Joyce lunges forward and drives it between cover-point and point for a superb boundary. That raced away to the fence in no time.
On a length just outside off, Joyce raises his arms and lets it go.
Beaten! Wood bowls it outside off on a fuller length, Joyce looks to go for the drive but is beaten by the zip from the surface. Good ball!
Back to the length, just outside off, Ed lets it go through happily.
FOUR! Poor line and punished! Wood strays on the pads, Joyce does not miss out and clips it to the fine leg fence. Nice shot, that.
Doles out a fuller length delivery outside off, Joyce comes forward and pushes it into the off side.
Mark Wood to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
On a length outside off, Paul hits it on the up to covers. A good start this for Willey.
Slants it on the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Another fuller length delivery on the stumps, Joyce pushes it through mid on for a couple of runs. He closed the face of the bat in time there.
Drifts it on the pads, Stirling cannot clip it. The ball goes off the pads towards the leg side and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Too full outside off, Stirling pushes it towards covers from his crease.
Second slip moves to short mid-wicket for Paul Stirling.
Off the mark! Fuller length delivery to begin with, Joyce looks to defend but gets it off the outer half through the vacant gully region for a single.
The players are out in the middle for the game. The two Ireland openers are Paul Stirling and Ed Joyce. England begin the proceedings with David Willey. Two slips in place. Here we go...
England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Alex Hales, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan(c), Jonny Bairstow, Sam Billings(wk), Adil Rashid, Liam Plunkett, David Willey, Mark Wood, Jake Ball.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, William Porterfield(c), Ed Joyce, Andrew Balbirnie, Niall O'Brien(wk), Kevin O'Brien, Gary Wilson, Stuart Thompson, George Dockrell, Tim Murtagh, Peter Chase.
TOSS - Ireland win the toss and opt to bat.

The hosts will look forward to these games to prepare for the Champions Trophy at home. They are hosting the Irish for the first time but will be aware that most of their opponents today have been their teammates in county cricket which should means everyone will be well aware of the conditions. With cloud cover expected throughout the day, expect the ball to dominate the proceedings. Stay tuned for the details from the toss.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the first ODI of the 2-match series between England and Ireland at the County Ground, Bristol. The visitors don't often get games against the big names and will be eager to make the most on offer. They are going through their first transition phase and will need the young guns in the team to step up to challenge the home side who even without some of their regulars are still a relatively strong side.
